answer.reason: The verses state what happened to Jabin: he oppressed Israel and was subdued and destroyed by them.

clauses.english: oppressed the children of Israel mightily for twenty years
clauses.quote: twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel

clauses.english: was subdued by God before Israel and then destroyed by them
clauses.quote: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

doubts: PSA 83:7 is marked but names Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, not Jabin, so it was left out.
PSA 83:9 only compares enemies to Jabin, so it was not used as an event.
